_note: Answer key for case_3, a deliberately messy copy of case_2 (fictional). Clinical content is the same as case_2; only the dates and one page break were changed. Findings are scored against sample_data/case_2/expected_output.json (case_3 has one extra page, BELL 000104, the continuation of the 06/20 visit). This file lists what the pipeline should do with each corrupted date.

date_cases.note: Letter O for zero. Correct it in code, record that it was corrected.
Header date is blank. The signature date is a candidate only: show it, flag it, do not silently use it as the visit date.
Machine fax stamp. Must never become an event date.

expect.candidate_source: previous page of the same visit (BELL 000103)

date_cases.note: Page has no date at all. Findings stay in the chronology as undated or as inferred from the previous page, and are flagged.
Form revision stamp. Ambiguous month/day order and irrelevant. Must not become an event date.

expect.year_source: signature date 02/11/2023 on the same page

must_not_happen: Any finding dated to a fax, print, certification, or form-revision date.
A date guessed silently: every inferred or corrected date carries a flag.
A finding disappearing because its page has no usable date.
